(+ loc.) marks, marks inwardly; takes as a sign; concentrates exclusively on, is completely taken up by; apprehends only ; Ja I 433, 16 (seṭṭhiputto oloketvā dantaṭṭhike ~aṃ gaṇhi, aṭṭhikasaññaṃ uppajji, sakalaṃ pi taṃ sarīraṃ aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikā viya paññāyi); IV 223, 21´ (cakkhuṃ ummīletvā itthirūpe ~aṃ mā gaṇheyyāsī ti); Vism 123, 6 (paṭhavīkasiṇaṃ uggaṇhanto paṭhaviyaṃ ~aṃ gaṇhāti kate vā akate vā sāntake no anantake …); 125, 7 (samena ākārena cakkhūni ummīletvā ~aṃ gaṇhantena bhāvetabbaṃ, na vaṇṇo paccavekkhitabbo na lakkhaṇaṃ manasikātabbaṃ); 196, 25 (yattha yattha asubhākāro paññāyati tattha tatth’ eva ~aṃ gahetvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ appanaṃ pāpetabban ti); 208, 30 (eko maṇḍūko bhagavato sare ~aṃ aggahesi); Ps III 68, 7 (diṭṭhadiṭṭhe ārammaṇe ~aṃ na gahetabbaṃ); Dhp-a I 15, 15 (ekissā itthiyā gītasaddaṃ sutvā sare ~aṃ gaṇhi); II 49, 3 (sā … dīpasikhāya ~aṃ gaṇhitvā ṭhitā va punappuna olokayamānā tejokasiṇārammaṇaṃ jhānaṃ nibbattetvā); Ap-a 198, 18 (jāle vātaṃ asaṅgam eva gacchamānaṃ disvā tasmiṃ ~aṃ aggahesi); — ° ânusāri(n) , mfn. , following attributes ; D III 249, 19 (animittā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā … atha ca pana me ~i viññāṇaṃ hotī ti; Sv 1036, 28 : rāganimittādīnaṃ c’ eva rūpanimittādīnaṃ cābhāvā animittā ti vuttā … vuttappabhedaṃ nimittaṃ anusaratī ti ~ī ti) = A III 292, 7 ≠ S IV 269, 6 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee nimittānusariviññāṇaṃ); Nett 25, 15 ; — °’- upalakkhaṇa , n. , ~ā, f. , observation of, attention to, marks or objects of note ; Vism 179, 28 (samantā ~aṃ ekādasavidhena nimittaggāho … sabbaṃ kathetabbaṃ); 181, 14 (samantā ~ā kimatthiyā kim-ānisaṃsā ti; Vism-mhṭ [ Be ] I 203, 13 : uddhumātakassa samantā pāsāṇādinimittasallakkhaṇā); — °- ggahaṇa , n. [nimitta + gahaṇa 1 ], apprehending an object or appearance (as distinguished in various ways); marking the characteristic features ; Vism 186, 34 (~’-aṭṭhaṃ cakkhuṃ ummīletvā); 192, 24 (ekādasavidhena ~aṃ); Th-a I 192, 15 (bhāvanācittassa ~e kusalo); — °- (g)gāha , m. [nimitta + gāha 2 ], 1. apprehending an object or appearance (as distinguished in various ways); marking the characteristic features ; Vism 179, 28 (ekādasavidhena ~o); 613, 18 (samādhissa ca ~ena); Sv 780, 25 (atibhojane ~o); — 2. apprehending, responding emotionally to, an object or appearance; grasping, occupying oneself with, external features or characteristics; exclusive concentration (on, loc.); being completely taken up (by, loc.) ; S IV 168, 16 (cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu anuvyañjanaso ~o; Spk III 4, 15 : hatthā sobhanā pādā sobhanā ti evaṃ anuvyañjanavasena ~o); Vism 209, 7 (aññatra bhagavato sare ~ā); Spk III 4, 16 (~o ti saṃsandetvā gahaṇaṃ anuvyañjanaggāho ti vibhattigahaṇaṃ); Dhp-a I 74, 15 (yo hi puggalo ~aṃ anuvyañjanaggāhaṃ gaṇhanto nakhā sobhanā ti gaṇhāti …); As 17, 5 (sare ~-mattaken’ eva kālaṃ katvā devaloke nibbattiṃsu); — °- (g)gāhi(n) , mfn. , apprehending, responding emotionally to, an object or appearance; grasping, occupying oneself with, external features or characteristics ; D I 70, 9 (bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā na ~ī hoti nānuvyañjanaggāhī) = Nidd I 367, 11 (Nidd-a I 392, 23 foll. : chandarāgavasena vuttappakāraṃ nimittaṃ na gaṇhāti); — °- pāṭhaka , m. , an interpreter of signs or omens ; Ja V 296, 18´ ; Mp III 320, 20 ; — °- sattamī , f. [ scil. vibhatti], ( gr.t.t. ) a locative indicating cause or ground ; Bv-a 267, 15 ; — °- sattha , n. [nimitta + sattha 3 ], the science of interpreting signs or omens ; Sv 92, 12 ; — animitta , mfn. and n. , 1. ( mfn. ) ( i ) free from (the apprehension of) marks or characteristics or attributes; without identifying or defining marks; indefinable, not to be predicated ; Vin III 92, 37 foll. (suññato vimokkho ~o vimokkho appaṇihito ~o … suññato samādhi ~o samādhi appaṇihito samādhi …; Sp 493, 25 : vimokkho … rāgadosamohehi suññattā suññato rāgadosamoha-nimittehi ~-ttā ~o rāgadosamohapaṇidhānaṃ abhāvato appaṇihito ti vuccati); V 221, 8 (~aṃ sīmaṃ sammannati); D II 100, 18 (yasmiṃ … samaye tathāgato sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā ekaccānaṃ vedanānaṃ nirodhā ~aṃ cetosamādhiṃ upasampajja viharati phāsukato … tasmiṃ samaye tathāgatassa kāyo hoti); III 249, 16 (~ā hi kho me cetovimutti bhāvitā … atha ca pana me nimittānusāri viññāṇaṃ hotī ti); M I 296, 32 foll. (dve … paccayā ~āya cetovimuttiyā samāpattiyā sabbanimittānaṃ ca amanasikāro ~āya ca dhātuyā manasikāro); 298, 23 (yāvatā kho āvuso ~ā cetovimuttiyo akuppā tāsaṃ cetovimutti aggam akkhāyati; Ps II 355, 6 foll. : ~ā cetovimuttiyo nāma terasa dhammā vipassanā cattāro āruppā cattāro maggā cattāri phalānī ti, tattha vipassanā niccanimittaṃ sukhanimittaṃ attanimittaṃ ugghāṭetī ti ~ā nāma, cattāro āruppā rūpanimittassa abhāvā ~ā nāma, maggaphalāni nimittakārakānaṃ kilesānaṃ abhāvena ~āni, nibbānaṃ pi ~am eva taṃ pana cetovimutti na hoti); III 107, 28 (bhikkhu … ~aṃ cetosamādhiṃ paṭicca manasikaroti ekattaṃ; Ps IV 153, 25 : vipassanācittasamādhiṃ, so hi niccanimittādivirahito ~o ti vuccati); 108, 15 (ayaṃ pi kho ~o cetosamādhi abhisaṅkhato abhisañcetayito, yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tad aniccaṃ nirodhadhamman ti pajānāti); Dhp 93 (suññato ~o ca vimokkho yesaṃ gocaro; Dhp-a II 172, 7 foll. : tīṇi pi c’ etāni nibbānass’ eva nāmāni, nibbānaṃ hi … rāgādinimittābhāvena ~aṃ tehi ca vimuttan ti ~o vimokkho); Sn 574 (~aṃ anaññātaṃ maccānaṃ idha jīvitaṃ; Pj II 457, 15 : ~an ti kiriyākāranimittavirahitaṃ); Paṭis II 36, 10 (suññaṃ idaṃ attena vā attaniyena vā ti so tattha nimittaṃ na karotī ti ~o vimokkho; Paṭis-a 553, 18 : aniccānupassanāvasena niccanimittaṃ na karoti); Dhs 506 (paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ ~aṃ); Vism 236, 13 foll. (~ato ti avavatthānato paricchedābhāvato ti attho, sattānaṃ hi jīvitaṃ vyādhi kālo ca dehanikkhepanaṃ gati pañc’ ete jīvalokasmiṃ ~ā na ñāyare; cf 230, 25 : ~ato … maraṇaṃ anussaritabbaṃ) quoted Ja II 58, 9´ ; Vism 658, 14 (~o vimokkho ti animittākārena nibbānaṃ ārammaṇaṃ katvā pavatto ariyamaggo); 668, 26 (yasmā pan’ esa aniccānupassanāya saṅkhārānaṃ ghanavinibbhogaṃ katvā niccanimitta-dhuvanimitta-sassatanimittāni pajahanto āgato tasmā ~o); Kkh 2 7, 14 (~ā nāma yā [sīmā] sabbena sabbaṃ nimittāni akittetvā sammatā hoti) = Sp 1401, 21 ; Sv 1036, 24 foll. (~ā cetovimuttī ti arahattaphalasamāpatti, sā hi rāganimittādīnaṃ c’ eva rūpanimittādīnaṃ cābhāvā ~ā ti vuttā; cf Mp III 347, 17 foll: ~ā cetovimuttī ti balavavipassanā, dīghabhāṇakā pana arahattaphalasamāpattī ti vadanti); Spk III 90, 18 (niccasukha-attanimittānaṃ amanasikārena ~aṃ … cetosamādhiṃ); — animittaṃ karoti, does not mark or note or indicate ; Vin III 238, 37 (~aṃ katvā pātetabbaṃ; Sp 693, 7 : nimittaṃ akatvā … patitokāsaṃ asamannāharantena pātetabban ti attho); Kkh 2 125, 6 (tena ~aṃ katvā va gūthaṃ viya chaḍḍetabbaṃ); — ( ii ) w ithout pudenda ; Vin II 271, 17 (upasampannāyo dissanti ~ā pi nimittamattā pi …); III 129, 24 (akkosati nāma ~ā si nimittamattā si …; Sp 548, 14 foll. : ~ā sī ti nimittarahitā si … itthīpaṇḍakā ti ~ā va vuccati); — ( iii ) without undesirable characteristics ;? D III 146, 20 (so imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ akhilaṃ ~aṃ akaṇṭakaṃ … abhivijiya ajjhāvasati; Sv 922, 6 foll. : niccoraṃ, corā hi … upaddavapaccayaṭṭhena nimittā … ti vuccanti); — 2. ( n. ) what is free from marks or attributes; of which nothing can be predicated ; S I 188, 23* (~aṃ ca bhāvehi; Spk I 272, 3 : niccādīnaṃ nimittānaṃ ugghāṭitattā vipassanā ~ā nāma) = Sn 342 ≠ Thī 105; Paṭis I 15, 6 (nimittaṃ saṅkhārā ~aṃ nibbānan ti abhiññeyyaṃ); 66, 20 (nimittaṃ abhibhuyyitvā ~aṃ pakkhandatī ti gotrabhū); Kv-a 180, 5 (~an ti sabbanimittarahitaṃ nibbānaṃ); — 3. ( mfn. ) without a reason or cause ; S V 213, 17 (taṃ ca ~aṃ anidānaṃ asaṅkhāraṃ appaccayaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ uppajjissatī ti n’ etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati); A I 82, 19 (sanimittā bhikkhave uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā no ~ā); — dunnimitta , n. , a bad omen; a sign of trouble ; Bv-a 288, 21 (idāni Māro āgamissatī ti paṭhamam eva anekarūpāni aniṭṭhāni ~āni pāturahesuṃ); Cp-a 93, 10 (ajja me dussupinaṃ diṭṭhaṃ ~āni ca uppannāni); — sanimitta , mfn. , 1. having a cause; arising from a cause ; S V 213, 16 (uppannaṃ kho me idaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ, taṃ ca kho ~aṃ sanidānaṃ sasaṅkhāraṃ sappaccayaṃ); A I 82, 18 (~ā bhikkhave uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā no animittā; Mp II 154, 2 : ~ā ti sakāraṇā); — 2. associated with attributes ;? As 223, 15 (vipassanā … nimittadhammesu caratī ti ~ā va hoti); — see also tannimittaka ( sv ta[d] ).

a: [ဒု+နယ။(ဒုဏ္ဏယ-ပြာ,[du+naya.(duṇṇaya-prā

,အဒ္ဓမာဂဓီ)] (၁)မကောင်းသဖြင့်-ဆောင်ခြင်း-ကျင့်ခြင်း၊ မကောင်းသော အကျင့်ကို ကျင့်ခြင်း။(တိ)(၂)ခဲယဉ်းသဖြင့် သိအပ်သော၊ သိနိုင်ခဲသော(အနက်စသည်)။,
dunnibbeṭha,ဒုန္နိဗ္ဗေဌ(တိ),[ဒု+နိဗ္ဗေဌ],[du+nibbeṭha],ခဲယဉ်းသဖြင့် ဖြေရှင်းအပ်သော၊ ဖြေရှင်းနိုင်ခဲသော၊ ဖြေဆိုနိုင်ခဲသော(ပြဿနာ-စသည်)။,
dunnibbāpaya,ဒုန္နိဗ္ဗာပယ(တိ),[ဒု+နိဗ္ဗာပယ],[du+nibbāpaya],ခဲယဉ်းသဖြင့် ငြိမ်းစေအပ်သော၊ ငြိမ်းစေနိုင်ခဲသော။,
dunniggaha,ဒုန္နိဂ္ဂဟ(တိ),[ဒု+နိဂ္ဂဟ။],[du+niggaha.],ခဲယဉ်းသဖြင့်-နှိပ်ကွပ်-နှိမ်နင်း-အပ်သော၊ နှိပ်ကွပ်-နှိမ်နင်း-ရန် ခဲယဉ်းသော(စိတ် စသည်)။,
dunniggahita,ဒုန္နိဂ္ဂဟိတ(တိ),[ဒု+နိဂ္ဂဟိတ။],[du+niggahita.],မကောင်းသဖြင့်-နှိပ်-နှိပ်ကွပ်-နှိမ်နင်း-အပ်သော(အယူ-စသည်)။,
dunniggamana,ဒုန္နိဂ္ဂမန(တိ),[ဒု+နိဂ္ဂမန],[du+niggamana],ခဲယဉ်းသဖြင့် ထွက်မြောက်အပ်သော၊ ထွက်မြောက်နိုင်ခဲသော။,
dunnihata,ဒုန္နိဟတ(တိ),[ဒု+နိဟတ],[du+nihata],မကောင်းသဖြင့် ငြိမ်းစေအပ်သော(ကံ-စသည်)။,
dunnijjhāpaya,ဒုန္နိဇ္ဈာပယ(ပု),[ဒု+နိဇ္ဈာပယ],[du+nijjhāpaya],ခဲယဉ်းသဖြင့်ရှုစေအပ်သော၊ ရှုစေနိုင်ခဲသော။,
dunnikkaya,ဒုန္နိက္ကယ(တိ),[ဒု+နိက္ကယ],[du+nikkaya],ဒုန္နိက္ကဍ္ဎိယ-ကြည့်။,
dunnikkaḍḍhiya,ဒုန္နိက္ကဍ္ဎိယ(တိ),[ဒု+နိက္ကဍ္ဎိယ],[du+nikkaḍḍhiya],ခဲယဉ်းသဖြင့်-ဆွဲငင်-နုတ်ပယ်-အပ်သော၊ ဆွဲငင်-နုတ်ပယ်-နိုင်ခဲသော။ ဒုန္နိက္ကယ-ကြည့်။,
dunnikkhama,ဒုန္နိက္ခမ(တိ),[ဒု+နိက္ခမ။],[du+nikkhama.],(က)ခဲယဉ်းသဖြင့် ထုတ်ယူအပ်သော၊ ထုတ်ယူနိုင်ခဲသော။(ခ)ခဲယဉ်းသဖြင့် ထွက်မြောက်အပ်သော၊ ထွက်မြောက်နိုင်ခဲသော။,
dunnikkhitta,ဒုန္နိက္ခိတ္တ(တိ),[ဒု+နိက္ခိတ္တ။(ဒုဏ္ဏိက္ခိတ္တ-ပြာ)],[du+nikkhitta.(duṇṇikkhitta-prā)],မကောင်းသဖြင့် ထားအပ်သော၊ အစဉ်မဟုတ်သောအားဖြင့် ထားအပ်သော။,
dunnimmadaya,ဒုန္နိမ္မဒယ(တိ),[ဒု+နိမ္မဒယ],[du+nimmadaya],ခဲယဉ်းသဖြင့် မာန်ယစ်ခြင်း ကင်းအောင် ပြုအပ်သော၊ မာန်ယစ်ခြင်းကင်းအောင် ပြုနိုင်ခဲသော။,
dunnimmaddanavisa,ဒုန္နိမ္မဒ္ဒနဝိသ(တိ),[ဒု+နိမ္မဒ္ဒန+ဝိသ],[du+nimmaddana+visa],ခဲယဉ်းသဖြင့်-နှိမ်နင်း-ပယ်ဖျောက်-အပ်သော အဆိပ်ရှိသော၊ နှိမ်နင်း-ပယ်ဖျောက်-နိုင်ခဲသော အဆိပ်ရှိသော(မြွေ-စသည်)။,
dunnipphādanīya,ဒုန္နိပ္ဖါဒနီယ(တိ),[ဒု+နိပ္ဖါဒနီယ],[du+nipphādanīya],ခဲယဉ်းသဖြင့် ပြီးစေအပ်သော၊ ပြီးစေနိုင်ခဲသော။,
dunnissārita,ဒုန္နိဿာရိတ(တိ),[ဒု+နိဿာရိတ],[du+nissārita],မကောင်းသဖြင့်-ထွက်သွားစေအပ်-နှင်ထုတ်အပ်-သော၊ သူ။,

dunniviṭṭha.p: [Du+niviṭṭha.(duṇṇiviṭṭha-prā)] (ti) CL=8 it is not good so it should be place, it is not good place (the end of the way, etc.,).
pn: Dunniviṭṭha. A Brahmin village in the Kāliṅga country. It lay on the road (along which Vessantara journeyed to Vaṅkagiri) from Jetuttara to the Ceti kingdom, five leagues from Arañjaragiri and ten from the Ceti country. It was the residence of Jūjaka and Amittatāpanā. Ja.vi.521, 541.
